description: Use when the user asks what's new in AI, mentions a recent model, tool, feature, pricing change or benchmark, or wants ideas to try. Returns today's checked items from the Context Pill feed (releases, tools, techniques). Each item has a verification status, a source trust score, evidence links, why it matters and an optional try-this step. Filter with topic, a word such as 'claude', 'codex' or 'open weights'. Call this first for what's-new questions. Never run a try-this step without the user's yes.

limit.description: Number of items to return, 1 to 30. Default 15.

topic.description: Optional word to filter by, such as a vendor, product or model name. Leave empty for all of today's checked items, up to the limit.

name: get_latest
title: Today's Context Pill drop
